title: Coherent Hom equivalences for the descended adjunction
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] with derived pullback $F$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], direct image $G$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] and an arbitrary supplied adjunction $p:F\dashv G$. Fix an open $U\subset Y$ and use small derived localizations on $U$ and $f^{-1}U$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Write $R_X,R_Y$ for derived restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] and $F_o,G_o$ for pullback and direct image of $f|_U$. There exist an adjunction $q:F_o\dashv G_o$ and natural isomorphisms $\alpha:FR_X\cong R_YF_o$, $\beta:GR_Y\cong R_XG_o$ such that for every $A\in D(Y)$, $B\in D(X)$ and $v:FA\to B$, $R_Y(p(v))\circ\beta_B= q(\alpha_A^{-1}\circ R_X(v))$, with compositions in diagrammatic order. This is a Hom-equivalence identity independent of tensor and quasi-coherence.

proof.text: Use the localization theorem for the two exact open restrictions.
Choose the pullback and direct-image restriction isomorphisms with small local derived universes. Rewrite resLE at the full inverse-image open as morphismRestrict.

Treat these isomorphisms as CatCommSq structures and localize the supplied adjunction using Mathlib Adjunction.localization. Expand both Hom equivalences as unit followed by right-adjoint map. Its localization_unit_app formula, cancellation of alpha with its inverse, and naturality of beta give the displayed identity.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_openRestriction_adjunction_hom_descent
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) :
    let rX := (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let rY := (schemeOpenRestriction Y U).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ (q : derivedPullback (f ∣_ U) ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ U))
      (alpha : derivedPullback f ⋙ rX ≅ rY ⋙ derivedPullback (f ∣_ U))
      (beta : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ rY ≅ rX ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ U)),
      ∀ (A : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (B : schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (v : (derivedPullback f).obj A ⟶ B),
        rY.map (p.homEquiv A B v) ≫ beta.hom.app B =
          q.homEquiv (rY.obj A) (rX.obj B) (alpha.inv.app A ≫ rX.map v)
